ruleDefinitions.name: Zscaler Uninstall Attempt
ruleDefinitions.description: Security applications must not be stopped, disabled, altered, bypassed, or removed.

sequences.name: Zscaler Uninstall Attempt
sequences.query: (event_code: "ProcessRollup2" AND platform:"windows" AND process_command_line: RGXi("ZSAInstaller") AND process_command_line: RGXi("uninstall\.exe") ) OR process_command_line: RGXi("/Applications/Zscaler/Zscaler Uninstaller.app|rm -f /Applications/Zscaler/")
